pages.text: Wants a room: walls, a floor and a ceiling, with no way out to the sky. At least 27 blocks of space.$(p)Grants:$(li)Sword damage, growing with the tier, up to +30%%.$(p)Tiers begin at a score of 5.

Will not count without:$(li)1 of $(l:soulhome:multiblocks/tags#smithing)any smithing$(/l)$(p)Rewards, most first:$(li)$(l:soulhome:multiblocks/tags#smithing)any smithing$(/l)$(li)any anvil$(li)$(l:soulhome:multiblocks/tags#armament)any armament$(/l)$(li)$(l:soulhome:multiblocks/tags#storage)any storage$(/l)$(li)Fletching Table$(p)Counts against it:$(li)$(l:soulhome:multiblocks/tags#bookshelves)any bookshelves$(/l)
pages.title: What counts

pages.text: A room of this kind can be one of two things, and which one is decided by what you put in it - not by choosing.$(p)Either way it scores the same and is worth the same. What changes is which gift it gives, never how large.
pages.title: What it is for

pages.text: The usual reading of the room. Grants:$(li)Sword damage, growing with the tier, up to +30%%.$(p)Leans this way:$(li)$(l:soulhome:multiblocks/tags#smithing)any smithing$(/l)$(li)any anvil
pages.title: Blade

pages.text: Grants instead:$(li)Arrow damage, growing with the tier, up to +30%%.$(p)Leans this way:$(li)Fletching Table$(li)Target$(li)Dispenser
pages.title: Quiver

pages.text: None of this is required, but building it well earns more than the blocks alone:$(li)Armament is 0-4 from forge, and storage is within 5 of forge.
pages.title: How you arrange it

pages.text: What those parts are:$(li)Armament: $(l:soulhome:multiblocks/tags#armament)any armament$(/l)$(li)Forge: $(l:soulhome:multiblocks/tags#smithing)any smithing$(/l)$(li)Storage: $(l:soulhome:multiblocks/tags#storage)any storage$(/l)
pages.title: How you arrange it

pages.text: Worth more for standing near the right neighbours - never required, only rewarded:$(li)$(l:soulhome:multiblocks/powder_magazine)Powder Magazine$(/l), sharing a wall$(li)$(l:soulhome:multiblocks/workshop)Workshop$(/l), with a way through between them, up to 12 blocks long
